media.policy: Only explicitly published media keys receive URLs. GIFs are never copied by this exporter.

provenance.note: Exported task counts count actual bundle artifacts; the source run index may report a different historical total. Historical trajectory runs are retained; latest=true matches the dashboard's default latest-per-model selection.

scoreSemantics.atomic_pass_rate: Recorded pass rate for atomic tasks.
scoreSemantics.binarySuccess: Derived all-target success: true only when recorded chainScore is exactly 1; null when unscored.
scoreSemantics.chainScore: Recorded fractional chain score k/N in [0, 1]; not binary success.
scoreSemantics.cumulative_mean_kn: Recorded mean k/N for cumulative tasks.
scoreSemantics.mean_grade: Mean fractional chain score, preserved from the patching report.
scoreSemantics.mean_reward: Mean binary all-target success, preserved separately from mean_grade.
scoreSemantics.taskDepth: Number of restoration targets; distinct from validation lineage depth.
